blocks.content:
Unicameral Legislature:
• Only Legislative Assembly exists

Bicameral Legislature:
• Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council exist

Parliament has the power to create or abolish a Legislative Council.
Parliament has the power to create or abolish a Legislative Council.

rows: Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council exist

items: Note that the power to create or abolish a Legislative Council rests with Parliament.
Differentiate between Unicameral (Assembly only) and Bicameral (Assembly + Council) setups.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: A Unicameral Legislature consists solely of the Legislative Assembly.
A Bicameral Legislature comprises both the Legislative Assembly and the Legislative Council.
Parliament holds the constitutional authority to create or abolish a Legislative Council.
